actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: No resident contributed more than 10 units in the last round, and my wallet (2.64) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I must broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow Aggressive Red rules. Look at latest round 8 contributions: Resident5 1.44, Resident6 3.15, others 0. No one >10. So rule: no resident contributed >10, wallet is 2.64 which is above free_rider_threshold? threshold 10, wallet 2.64 <10, so cannot rest. Must broadcast warning. Also can do at most one physical action. Could rest? Wallet below threshold so cannot rest (rule says if wallet above threshold rest, else if cannot rest broadcast). So we broadcast warning. No physical action. Return broadcast.
